title: Circumcision status and reported lifetime sex with men among U.S. men aged 20–59 in NHANES 2005–2016
status: Consolidated specification of completed exploratory analyses; not a new preregistration
population: Recorded male, age 20–59, positive examination weight; complete cases as required by each outcome/model
design: All positive-weight examined records retained; cycle-nested strata and PSUs; domain inference

behavior_specific.multiplicity: Holm within four lifetime and four past-year tests, plus all eight

identity.decomposition: Descriptive decomposition of the raw prevalence gap, not causal attribution

comparisons: change in standardized prevalence difference after residence/language adjustment
multiple male partners within heterosexual MSM
recent male partner within heterosexual MSM
explanatory.variance: Stratified delete-one-PSU jackknife with paired restandardization
explanatory.multiplicity: Holm five; failed tests retained as correction placeholders only

numerical_implementation: src/frequentist/; this document describes the implementation and does not dynamically override its formulas
supplement: Corrected Maloney circumcised-only masculinity, general visibility, and regret analysis; optional via --with-maloney; see docs/methods.md.
